answer: A farm has to recruit observers outside its own infrastructure, which means paying parties whose interest is to report honestly. Cosignatures are collected in whisper, verified in falcon, and river names every witness. Each submission needs cosignature from 4 independent nodes that observed it arrive, and a node cannot cosign more than 24 submissions per epoch. A 174 account operation therefore ties up 31 million dollars of idle capital. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
